messages.body:

messages.body:
On Tue, Dec 21, 2021, Suguna Sakkiah wrote:
>
>I am getting an error message while running a file run_cmake. Below the
>content in the run_cmake and error message
??? I don't see any error messages. Your build report looks fine:
>-- Building Tools:
>-- addles amberlite ambpdb antechamber cifparse cphstats cpptraj emil etc few gbnsr6 gem.pmemd leap lib mdgx mm_pbsa mmpbsa_py moft nab ndiff-2.00 nfe-umbrella-slice nmode nmr_aux packmol_memgen paramfit parmed pbsa pdb4amber pmemd pymsmt pysander python_site_packages pytraj reduce rism sander saxs sebomd sff sqm xray xtalutil
....
>-- Build files have been written to: /data/Amber/amber20_src/build
>
>If the cmake build report looks OK, you should now do the following:
>
> make install
> source /data/Amber/amber20/amber.sh
You just need to continue with the "make install" step.
....good luck...dac
p.s. If I'm missing something here (not all that unlikely) please state
explicitly what error message is bothering you.
